title: The End Justifies the Mean: A Linear Ranking Rule for Proportional Sequential Decisions
reasoning: The paper evaluates and benchmarks aggregation rules for decision-making using datasets focused on moral and ethical dilemmas, such as the Moral Machine dataset and Kidney Exchange. It specifically discusses the aggregation of moral preferences and the avoidance of a 'tyranny of the majority' in the context of AI alignment and RLHF.
